Setup.title: Almost there!
Setup.body: This map needs a Supabase project to power it. Add your NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to .env.local, then run the SQL in supabase/schema.sql.
